name: GitHub
description: Lets your agents work GitHub the way you do — read issues and pull requests, watch CI runs, inspect diffs, and open PRs — through the official `gh` command line tool, with every outward-facing write gated by your approval.
author: Bakin

secrets.name: GH_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub personal access token. Optional — leave it empty if you have already run `gh auth login` on this machine, which is the better path for your own account. Set it to give agents a separate, narrower identity.
